Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_coll_check VARCHAR2(1) := 'Y';
begin
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select distinct unit_id
 into :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 from collection_date_changes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 message('Unit does not have collection date changes');
 temp_coll_check := 'N';
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_coll_check = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.latest_coll_date
 from units
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 select substr(user_last_name || ', '|| user_first_name,1,32)
 into :coll_info.user_name
 from system_users
 where substr(system_users.user_id,5,6) = :change_user_id
 and system_users.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
